consistency_of_reported_figures.comment: Nominal debt fell ~1.9m more than the cash paid: bonds bought back below par (the Q3 report mentions realised price gains on paying down selected loans) and/or the held-for-sale debt being at fair value rather than nominal.

version_A_superseded.assumption: Held-for-sale debt 26,954 = debt on all four sold properties. Superseded: the 2025 annual report (note 27) shows it was a single property (per user: Handelsvej 21).

bridge.item: Registered principal, realkreditpantebreve on FED-owned properties (tingbog 04.11.2026)
less: early redemptions on retained properties = 89,674 - 26,954

version_B_current.assumption: Debt repaid on the four sold properties = sale price 86,875 - ~37,000 freed liquidity = ~49,875. The ~37m is approximate ('godt 37 mio.' / 'i størrelsesordenen 37 mio.') and is also net of transaction costs, so the sold-property debt is ~49.9m at most; every 1m more freed liquidity lowers it by 1m and raises the redemptions on retained properties by 1m.

bridge.item: Registered principal, realkreditpantebreve on FED-owned properties (tingbog 04.11.2026)
less: voluntary redemptions on retained properties = 89,674 - ~49,875

residual_explained.item: Registered principal already above outstanding debt at 31.12.2025 on retained properties: 725,879 - (726,750 - ~22,921 debt on the three sold properties that were not held for sale)
Nominal reduction in excess of cash paid in 2026 (see consistency check)

version_B_current.conclusion: Of the 76.3m by which the tingbog exceeds the reported nominal debt, ~22m is repayment before 2026 not reflected in the registered principal, ~52m is 2026 afdrag and voluntary redemptions on retained properties, and ~2m is buy-backs below par / fair-value effects. The registered principal did NOT match the year-end 2025 nominal debt for the retained properties; the 0.9m match in version A came from the wrong held-for-sale assumption.

debt_by_loan_type_dkk_m.basis: FED-reported split: 31.12.25 ca. 24% fixed 4% / 42% F5 / 34% CIBOR6 of the 752.8m portfolio (AR2025); 30.09.26 ca. 21% / 40% / 39%, applied to the 649.6m nominal debt (Q3 note 3; the Q3 management review states the split on the 643.6m book portfolio, ~1m lower per class). 'ca.' whole percentages = about +/-3.2m per class at 30.09.26 and +/-3.8m at 31.12.25.
notes: Tingbog classification: 'Fast rente' = realkreditpantebrev without 'Rentetilpasning' in the special terms; all others carry 'Rentetilpasning'. The tingbog does not say whether a rentetilpasning loan is F5 or CIBOR6, so those two are compared combined.
31.12.25 amounts include the loans on the four properties sold 1 July 2026 (their pantebreve are now cancelled in the tingbog).
debt_by_loan_type_dkk_m.interpretation: The fixed 4% class fell ~44m in 2026 (range ~37-51m given the rounded percentages) although none of the fixed loans sits on a sold property, which matches the ~40m voluntary redemptions in version B. The rentetilpasning classes fell ~59m, about the ~50m debt on the sold properties plus afdrag. So the 2026 early redemptions went mainly into the two fixed 4% loans (Baltorpvej 156-172: 97.1m Obligationslån; Kærup Industrivej 1: 90.0m). The tingbog cannot show how the redemptions were split between those two loans. Supporting: the Q3 report mentions realised price gains on paying down selected loans, which fits buying back 4% bonds below par. At 30.09.26 ~50.7m of the 76.3m tingbog excess sits in the fixed class and ~25.6m in the rentetilpasning class.
